settings.profileHint: Your name appears in the dashboard greeting. Turn daily motivation on or off below, or add your own lines in Daily messages.
settings.displayNameHelp: Optional. Up to 40 characters. Shown as “Hello, {name}” on the dashboard.
settings.dailyMotivationEnabled: Show daily motivation on the dashboard
settings.customDailyMessagesHelp: Add up to 10 messages (200 characters each). One is picked at random each local calendar day and mixed with built-in messages.
settings.customDailyMessagesEmpty: No custom messages yet. Add one above.
settings.customDailyMessagesMax: Maximum of 10 custom messages reached. Remove one to add another.
motivation.msg01: Small steps today beat perfect plans tomorrow.
motivation.msg02: Showing up is most of the work — nice work being here.
motivation.msg03: One focused minute beats zero perfect minutes.
motivation.msg04: Your future self will thank you for this session.
motivation.msg05: Progress is built from ordinary days like this one.
motivation.msg06: Listen once, remember twice — keep going.
motivation.msg07: Consistency beats intensity. You are building consistency.
motivation.msg08: Every rep strengthens the habit, not just the skill.
motivation.msg09: Curiosity counts as practice too — stay curious.
motivation.msg10: You do not need to be perfect to be improving.
motivation.msg11: A little practice is infinitely more than none.
motivation.msg12: Trust the process; the results will catch up.
motivation.msg13: Today is a good day to understand one more sentence.
motivation.msg14: Celebrate showing up — the rest follows.
motivation.msg15: Your streak of effort matters more than any single day.
settings.levelFrameworkHint: Switching frameworks does not delete your library. Tags outside the active set appear under “Legacy”. JLPT and CEFR are built-in; Custom uses your own list below.
settings.pauseUnfocused: Pause counting when the YouTube tab loses focus
settings.pauseHelp: Recommended so background playback does not add practice time while you work elsewhere.
settings.showWatchPanelHelp: Puts the floating panel back at the bottom-right of the YouTube page and expands it. Use this if you moved it off-screen or it vanished after an extension update. Have a YouTube tab open, then click here and switch to that tab (refresh it if the panel still does not appear).
settings.showWatchPanelNoTab: No YouTube tab is open. Open a video on youtube.com, then try again.
settings.showWatchPanelNeedsRefresh: Found your YouTube tab but the extension is not connected to it yet (common after updating the extension). Click OK, then press Ctrl+Shift+R on the YouTube page to hard-refresh, and click Show watch panel again.
settings.showWatchPanelPartial: Updated {ok} YouTube tab(s). {failed} tab(s) could not be reached — refresh those YouTube pages and try again.
settings.notificationsIntro: Two separate controls: the frequent +1 XP alert while you practice, and occasional browser alerts for rank and achievements.
settings.watchPanelXpToastsHelp: Shows the short “+1 XP” popup on YouTube about once per minute of counted practice. Turn off if that is distracting. Your XP bar and goal ring still update.
settings.learningFocusHideRecs: Hide sidebar recommendations on saved videos
settings.learningFocusHideRecsHelp: On the normal /watch page, library videos hide the sidebar and Shorts shelf so the player stays centered. Turn off to keep YouTube recommendations. Not used on Shorts URLs or the mini player.
settings.calendarShowPracticeTimeHelp: When on, day tooltips include how long you practiced. The year heatmap stays red, green, and gold; days without data stay gray.
settings.howCountedBody: Seconds accrue only when “Count practice time” is on, the player is playing, the page is visible, and (with the option above) the tab is focused. Daily buckets use your local date. Per-video totals map sessions to each saved id.
settings.dataHint: Everything stays on this device in Chrome’s storage. Export or restore a full JSON backup, or wipe all extension data (cannot be undone).
dash.completedIntro: Videos you marked complete on YouTube. Undo here or from the watch panel.
dash.completedEmpty: No completed videos yet. Finish a video on YouTube and mark it complete from the panel.
dash.libraryEmptyFiltered: No videos match your filters or search.
dash.libraryWelcomeLead: Open any video and use the floating panel to save it to your library. Set a difficulty level if you like — practice time is optional.
dash.libraryWelcomeHintClose: when you want study time to count.
dash.searchPlaceholder: Search for a title or channel…
dash.statsByLevelHint: Buckets follow your active framework ({fw}). Other tags roll up into Legacy.
settings.customLevelsHelp: Up to 15 levels, 32 characters each. Allowed: letters, numbers, spaces, and . _ + - ( ). Empty or invalid lines are skipped. If nothing valid remains, defaults are used.
dash.restoreReadError: Could not read that file. Make sure it is valid JSON from an export.
dash.restoreBadFormat: Backup must be a JSON object (same format as Export JSON).
dash.confirmRestoreBody: Replace all {app} data on this device with this backup? Current data will be removed unless you exported it first.
dash.confirmClearBody: Clear all data for {app}? This removes your library, practice time, and settings. This cannot be undone.
dash.goalsIntro: Three rings track today, this calendar week (Mon–Sun), and this month (from the 1st through today). Enter only your daily target below — weekly and monthly targets follow your calendar.
dash.goalsDailyHint: Minutes per day. Weekly = daily × 7; monthly = daily × days in this month. Clear the field to remove all goal targets.
dash.remindersHint: When enabled, browser notifications fire when you reach your daily practice target and once in the evening if you have not. The extension already declares notification permission; your OS may still block toasts.
dash.remindersHourHint: Leave blank to use 8:00 PM. After this hour, if your daily goal is still not met, you may get one reminder per day.
dash.chartAria: Practice time per day, last seven days
dash.streakNone: No streak — log at least 1 minute today to start one.
dash.streakAriaNone: Streak is zero. Log at least 1 minute on a day to begin a streak.
dash.streakAria: {n} consecutive days, each with at least 1 minute logged.
dash.chartKeyFlawlessMonth: Flawless month — practiced every tracked day
dash.chartKeyFlawlessYear: Flawless year — gold outline on calendar
dash.practiceDayCreditHint: Red = under 1 minute. Green = 1+ minute. Streaks count full minutes only (60s+).
panel.saveToLibraryWhenSavedHint: Shows a highlighted note here (under the status line) with the saved title, channel, and the level selected in the list.
panel.countHintFocused: Counts seconds while the video plays and this tab is visible (switch tabs to pause).
panel.countHintUnfocused: Counts seconds while the video plays and the page is visible; tab focus not required.
panel.countHintOff: Save this video to your library to count practice time.
panel.homeFeedPickAttention: Tap any video thumbnail or title on this page (home, search, subscriptions…) to link it to JustPractice — then you can save it. Or open a /watch or /shorts URL.
panel.markCompleteHint: Mark this video as finished in your library
panel.markIncompleteHint: Remove the completed mark from this video
path.title: Today
path.subtitle: Your shortest path across today's watch goal.
path.goalMetSub: You crossed the line. Start a new path or call it a day.
path.regenerateConfirm: Replace your current plan? Progress on these steps will reset.
path.noGoal: Set a daily goal to get today's path
path.shortfall: You're about {minutes} min short with your saved videos
path.unknownDuration: Loading length for {count} videos from YouTube…
path.loadingDurationsBody: JustPractice is fetching video lengths for {count} saved videos. This usually takes a few seconds — the trail will appear here automatically.
path.emptyBody: Save videos to your library on YouTube to build a path.
popup.tipPractice: Turn on Count practice time on a video.
popup.pauseUnfocused: Pause counting when the YouTube tab loses focus
popup.pauseHelp: Recommended: avoids counting background playback while you work elsewhere.
popup.learningFocusHideRecs: Hide sidebar recommendations on saved videos
popup.learningFocusHideRecsHelp: Same as Dashboard → Settings → Learning focus. Off = normal YouTube layout on library videos.
popup.helpStats: Time accumulates only when “Count practice time” is on for a video, playback is running, the tab is visible, and (by default) the tab is focused.
popup.libraryEmpty: Your library is empty. Open a video on YouTube and use Save to library in the panel.
popup.noMatches: No videos match your search or filter.
notif.dailyGoalMetMessage: You practiced {duration} today. Keep it up.
notif.dailyGoalNudgeMessage: Still {remaining} to go today. You've got time.
settings.xpNotificationsHelp: System notification when your rank increases or you unlock an achievement — not the per-minute +1 XP popup above.
progress.journeySubtitle: Your rank is the milestone — XP is momentum — achievements are trophies along the path.
progress.xpGuideIntro: XP rewards real practice and habits. It does not come from achievements themselves — trophies unlock when you hit milestones.
progress.xpGuideEarnPractice: Practice time: 1 XP per full minute while “Count practice time” is on, the video is playing, the tab is visible, and (if enabled in Settings) the tab is focused. Seconds are saved in the background about every 15 seconds.
progress.xpGuideEarnDaily: Daily goal met: +25 XP once per calendar day when you have a daily goal set (Goals tab) and you reach it. Granted on the next practice save after the goal is met.
progress.xpGuideEarnStreak: Streak day: +10 XP once per day when your streak is 2+ days and today already has at least 1 full minute of credited practice (60+ seconds).
progress.xpGuideEarnComplete: First completion: +15 XP the first time you mark a library video complete (once per video).
progress.xpGuideMultiWeekend: Weekend: 2× practice XP on local Saturday and Sunday (shown as “2× weekend XP active” when it applies).
progress.xpGuideMultiPrestige: Prestige: +5% practice XP per prestige level, up to +50% at prestige 10. Bonuses and first-complete XP are not multiplied.
progress.xpGuideRankBody: Your rank is computed from cycle XP. Each rank needs more XP than the last; the ring and bar show progress within your current rank toward the next. At rank 120 you can prestige (see below).
progress.xpGuideCycleBody: Cycle XP is your current prestige run — it sets your rank and can reset to 0 when you prestige. Lifetime XP is the running total across all cycles and never goes down.
progress.xpGuideAchievementsNote: Achievements are separate badges (library size, hours watched, streaks, rank, prestige). They do not grant XP; they celebrate what you already did.
progress.prestigeReadyLead: You've reached Rank 120 — ready to prestige?
progress.prestigeReadyHint: Reset your rank to 1 and start a new cycle. You keep achievements, library, practice history, and settings. Gain +5% practice XP per prestige (up to +50%).
progress.confirmPrestige: Enter Prestige? Your cycle rank resets to 1 and cycle XP goes to zero. Lifetime XP, achievements, library, and practice history are kept.
progress.prestigeFailed: Could not prestige. Reach Rank 120 first.
progress.achievementsIntro: Trophies earned from your library, watch time, streaks, and rank.
